text:
I'm not saying he's the best. I'm not saying it's just … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS I'm not saying he's the best. I'm not saying it's just …
 HoopsHype Nov. 4, 2026, 5:44 p.m. ET Spurs coach Mitch Johnson considers Vassell to be the "most consistent person on the roster." It's a designation earned from the plethora of roles mastered over the course of a career in San Antonio that heads into Year 7. And his most important role happens off the court. "I think that's a fair statement," Johnson told ESPN. "I also think we thought of everything. But I don't know how long we gave that one a thought. I'm not saying he's the best. I'm not saying it's just on the court. I just think he's reached this level of consistency, whether it's being comfortable in his own skin, being at ease with who he is as a person, as a player. I feel he's reached his prime, which can be a little bit of a lightning-rod word, I know. But it just feels like he's so dependable in every single way, regardless of production or outcome."
